english: This bills every operator and group with commission ready by the end of that week. It's safe to run again: nothing already billed is billed twice, and anyone who already has that week's statement is skipped.
swahili: Hii hutoza kila mwendeshaji na kikundi chenye kamisheni iliyo tayari kufikia mwisho wa wiki hiyo. Ni salama kuiendesha tena: hakuna kinachotozwa mara mbili, na yeyote ambaye tayari ana taarifa ya wiki hiyo anarukwa.

english: Every weekly commission statement, with what was invoiced and what has been paid. Payments arrive at Fikisha's paybill; record each one here.
swahili: Kila taarifa ya kamisheni ya wiki, pamoja na kilichotozwa na kilicholipwa. Malipo huingia kwenye paybill ya Fikisha; rekodi kila moja hapa.

english: Your credits are larger than this week's commission, so there is nothing to pay.
swahili: Punguzo lako ni kubwa kuliko kamisheni ya wiki hii, kwa hivyo hakuna cha kulipa.

english: Payment details will follow. When you pay, use {{reference}} as the account number.
swahili: Maelezo ya malipo yatafuata. Unapolipa, tumia {{reference}} kama namba ya akaunti.

english: No new jobs this week; this statement only carries a credit.
swahili: Hakuna kazi mpya wiki hii; taarifa hii ina punguzo tu.

english: Commission statement — not a tax invoice. Tax invoices will follow once Fikisha's eTIMS invoicing is in place.
swahili: Taarifa ya kamisheni — si ankara ya kodi. Ankara za kodi zitafuata mara Fikisha itakapoanza kutoa ankara kupitia eTIMS.

english: Pay from your own M-Pesa. Fikisha records your payment here once it arrives.
swahili: Lipa kutoka M-Pesa yako mwenyewe. Fikisha itarekodi malipo yako hapa yakifika.

english: The commission goes on your weekly statement once the dispute window closes.
swahili: Kamisheni itawekwa kwenye taarifa yako ya wiki muda wa malalamiko ukiisha.

english: Your first statement appears the Monday after a completed job's dispute window closes.
swahili: Taarifa yako ya kwanza itatokea Jumatatu baada ya muda wa malalamiko wa kazi iliyokamilika kuisha.

english: Each week Fikisha adds up its commission on your completed jobs into one statement. You pay it to Fikisha's M-Pesa paybill. Fikisha never holds the fare.
swahili: Kila wiki Fikisha hujumlisha kamisheni yake kwenye kazi zako zilizokamilika katika taarifa moja. Unalipa kupitia paybill ya M-Pesa ya Fikisha. Fikisha haishiki nauli kamwe.
